name: list_pages
description: List the open pages with their ids, addresses and titles.

name: new_page
description: Open a new page, optionally at an address, and select it.

url.description: The address to open. Leave out for a blank page.

name: select_page
description: Make a page the one the other tools act on.

name: navigate_page
description: Open an address in the selected page and wait for it to finish loading.

url.description: The address to open: http, https or about:blank.

name: navigate_history
description: Go back or forward in the selected page's history.

Direction.description: Which way to go in the page's history.

name: take_snapshot
description: List the elements on the selected page with a uid for each; the uids work until the page navigates.

name: click_by_uid
description: Click an element from the last snapshot.

uid.description: An element's uid from the last take_snapshot.

name: hover_by_uid
description: Move the pointer over an element from the last snapshot.

uid.description: An element's uid from the last take_snapshot.

name: fill_by_uid
description: Replace a field's content with a value, or choose an option in a select.

uid.description: An element's uid from the last take_snapshot.

value.description: The text to put in the field, or the option to choose in a select.

name: type_text
description: Type text into the element that has focus.

text.description: The text to type into the element that has focus.

name: press_key
description: Press a key or a combination such as Control+a.

key.description: A key name such as Enter, Tab, Escape or ArrowDown, a character, or a combination such as Control+a.

name: get_page_text
description: Return the visible text of the selected page.

name: screenshot_page
description: Take a PNG screenshot of the selected page.

name: upload_file_by_uid
description: Choose a file from the shared files folder in a file input from the last snapshot.

uid.description: The file input's uid from the last take_snapshot.

filePath.description: The file to upload: a path inside the shared files folder, absolute or relative to it.

name: list_downloads
description: List the files the browser has downloaded in the cell.

name: fetch_download
description: Copy a finished download to the downloads folder inside the shared files folder.
